dawn-paper:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production high-resolution watercolour background for MuCLI's Paper theme, artwork named dawn-paper.
Create one finished abstract landscape painting, not a UI mockup or a presentation. Output a wide landscape at the highest available native resolution, ideally 3840 x 2160 or higher, 16:9.
A luminous apricot and dusty rose dawn sky dissolves into layered misty lilac hills and a few soft lagoon-coloured water glazes, with a hint of sage meadow near the lower edges. Warm ivory unpainted paper ground #F8F6F1. The atmosphere is delicate, calm, minimal and refined. Large gentle asymmetrical shapes with ample quiet space in the middle. Colour and visible pigment texture concentrated at top, upper right and outer sides; leave the bottom quarter almost unpainted ivory with a gradual organic dissolve, so the painting blends into the canvas of a productivity application. A whisper of lilac through the left side.
Authentic transparent wet-on-wet hand-painted watercolour: fine cold-press paper tooth, irregular capillary feathering, subtle granulation, dried pigment pooling and translucent overlapping glazes; painterly detail stays crisp at native pixel level, large shapes remain soft. Tactile fine-art painting, never Gaussian-blurred blobs or a digital smooth gradient. Soft atmospheric landscape suggestion only; no hard outlined hills, no detailed scenery.
Restrained palette anchored in apricot #F2A36B, rose #E58A9E, lilac #B39DDB, lagoon #5FA3AB and sage #8DBF6A. About 70% exposed warm ivory paper. Low contrast suitable behind frosted glass.
Edge-to-edge image, flat scan of the artwork. No text, lettering, logos, frame, border, horizon line across the image, sun disk, objects, people, buildings, mountains with peaks, photographic lighting, 3D, neon or excessive speckles.
